Junior AI Automation Engineer
Brightpath Logistics · Remote (US) · Full-time

Brightpath is a 90-person logistics software company. We are hiring a Junior AI Automation Engineer to join our 4-person internal automation team and help us adopt AI agents across operations.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain internal automations using no-code/low-code tools (Zapier, n8n) and simple Python scripts.
- Help configure LLM-powered agents for customer-support triage and document extraction, under the guidance of a senior engineer.
- Write documentation and run small training sessions for operations staff.
- Monitor workflows and fix broken automations.

What we're looking for
- 0–2 years of experience (new grads and bootcamp graduates welcome).
- Some Python experience.
- Curiosity about AI agents and workflow automation.
- Strong communication skills.

Compensation: $85,000–$100,000 base. Remote within the US. Reports to the Automation Team Lead.
edge_note: 0-2 years, no-code heavy, $85-100K: seniority and comp mismatch for a senior candidate.
